Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Between-group differences in BAS Factor Scores We calculated factor scores for each group by taking the mean of responses to items associated with each factor. Results of independent samples t-tests showed no significant differences between Malay and Chinese participants on either of the factor scores: General Body Appreciation (Malay M = 3.63, SD = .86, α = .95; Chinese M = 3.73, SD = .85, α = .95), t(589) = 1.40, p > .05, and; Body Image Investment (Malay M = 3.45, SD = .98, α = .74; Chinese M = 3.46, SD = .97, α = .71), t(589) = 1.01, p > .05.

section_summary.extract_value: This section reports between-group comparisons of BAS factor scores for Malay and Chinese participants using independent samples t-tests. No significant differences were found for General Body Appreciation or Body Image Investment.
